initial_arguments.name: M3: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
initial_arguments.details: Build ingestion and analysis for application logs: define the log schema and parsing rules, ingest from log sources, parse and normalize entries, compute error rates and usage metrics, and expose aggregated metrics for the dashboard. Exit milestone: log metrics refresh on a schedule and are queryable by the visualization layer.

initial_arguments.name: M4: Visualization Components
initial_arguments.details: Design and build the dashboard UI: layout and navigation, reusable chart components, customer analytics views, log/health views, filtering and date-range controls, and loading/empty/error states. Exit milestone: all planned views render real data from the processing pipelines and pass UX review.

initial_arguments.name: M5: Integration, Testing & Deployment
initial_arguments.details: Wire the data pipelines to the visualization layer, add end-to-end and performance testing, set up monitoring/alerting, document the system, and deploy to production with a rollback plan. Exit milestone: dashboard live in production with passing tests, monitoring, and runbook documentation.

args.details: Validate incoming CSV files against the documented data contracts: required columns present, correct types, value ranges, and referential integrity. Fail the run early with a clear, actionable error when the file-level schema is invalid. Deliverable: schema validation module with unit tests.
args.name: Validate CSV schema against data contracts

initial_arguments.name: Implement CSV schema validation & data quality checks
initial_arguments.details: Validate incoming CSVs against the data contracts: required columns, types, ranges, and referential checks. Quarantine malformed rows with clear error reasons and emit a quality report per run. Deliverable: validation module + quality report.
